shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "cat AGENTS.md && printf '\\n--- package.json ---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- app/page.tsx ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && printf '\\n--- app/layout.tsx ---\\n' && sed -n '1,200p' app/layout.tsx && printf '\\n--- root files ---\\n' && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | head -n 100"

/bin/bash -c "rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head -n 80; printf '\\n--- docs references to after() ---\\n'; rg -n 'after\\(|after.*response|schedule.*after|After' node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head -n 100"

/bin/bash -c "cat next.config.ts && printf '\\n--- tsconfig ---\\n' && cat tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- project docs/instructions ---\\n' && cat GEMINI.md && printf '\\n' && cat CLAUDE.md && printf '\\n--- next version ---\\n' && node -p \"require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version\""

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/after.md && printf '\\n--- route page docs server component context ---\\n' && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/page.md && printf '\\n--- runtime docs mentions analytics ---\\n' && rg -n 'analytics|logging|third-party|fetch\\(' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/analytics.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides 2>/dev/null | head -n 80"

/bin/bash -c "rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference | rg 'connection|route-segment-config' | sort && printf '\\n--- route segment dynamic guidance ---\\n' && sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/connection.md 2>/dev/null && sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/route-segment-config.md 2>/dev/null"
/bin/bash -c 'git status --short && git diff -- app/page.tsx app/analytics.ts tsconfig.json && nl -ba app/page.tsx && nl -ba app/analytics.ts'
/bin/bash -c "git diff -- package.json tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- timestamps ---\\n' && stat -c '%y %n' package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json next-env.d.ts .next 2>/dev/null"

/bin/bash -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: tsconfig.json
@@
-    \"lib\": [
-      \"dom\",
-      \"dom.iterable\",
-      \"esnext\"
-    ],
+    \"lib\": [\"dom\", \"dom.iterable\", \"esnext\"],
@@
-    \"jsx\": \"react-jsx\",
+    \"jsx\": \"preserve\",
@@
-      \"@/*\": [
-        \"./*\"
-      ]
+      \"@/*\": [\"./*\"]
@@
-  \"include\": [
-    \"next-env.d.ts\",
-    \"**/*.ts\",
-    \"**/*.tsx\",
-    \".next/types/**/*.ts\",
-    \".next/dev/types/**/*.ts\"
-  ],
-  \"exclude\": [
-    \"node_modules\"
-  ]
+  \"include\": [\"next-env.d.ts\", \"**/*.ts\", \"**/*.tsx\", \".next/types/**/*.ts\"],
+  \"exclude\": [\"node_modules\"]
 }
*** Delete File: next-env.d.ts
*** End Patch
PATCH
node -e 'require(\"node:fs\").rmSync(\".next\", { recursive: true, force: true })'
git status --short"

/bin/bash -c "git status --short && printf '\\n--- tracked diff ---\\n' && git diff -- app/page.tsx tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- analytics helper ---\\n' && nl -ba app/analytics.ts && printf '\\n--- page ---\\n' && nl -ba app/page.tsx"
